decisions.reason: The existing message-143 MODIFY already captures the qualifying referral-mint trigger, current-holder recipient, $5 amount, immediate timing, and wallet destination.
The existing message-143 MODIFY already captures the wallet requirement for receiving affiliate commissions; the refined revenue-allocation structure requires no further access-state change.
Conditioning the $5 affiliate allocation on use of a referral code does not change the $15 primary mint price or its no-hidden-fees condition.
The existing message-143 MODIFY already records that the purchaser, as current NFT holder, receives future commissions when the transferred referral code is used.
The affiliate-allocation condition does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.
The affiliate-allocation refinement does not change Transak, its supported payment methods, or the lack of a preexisting crypto or wallet requirement for fiat minting.
The source Event changes the affiliate allocation for referral-coded primary mints, not secondary-sale royalty enforcement, funding, ticket generation, or founder allocation.
The affiliate commission allocation is independent of the Big Block prize amount, draw trigger, ticket rules, and pool funding.
The affiliate commission allocation is independent of the Small Block prize amount, draw condition, ticket rules, and pool funding.
The commission-allocation refinement does not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
The affiliate commission condition does not alter badge thresholds, award destination, enabled badges, or current badge function.
The FAQ baseline was introduced from the same source message and already encompasses its referral-commission explanation; no additional state change is required.
